videos.overview: The "House and Home Show" is coming to feature the super-tidy Jane Kangaroo.

videos.title: The wubbulous world of Dr. Seuss
videos.overview: Larry Nooly and his family are going to the Lodge at beautiful Lake Mulloon.

videos.title: The Adventures of Paddington Bear: The Case of the Doubtful Dummy/The Greatest Paddington on Earth/Paddington Goes to Court
videos.overview: One foggy evening, Paddington spies a kidnapping/Paddington is a helpful bear even when he doesn't know he's helping./Mr. Gruber brings Paddington to visit the Law Courts. But they get there only to realize that the visitor's gallery is locked.

videos.overview: Paddington does a wonderful imitation of a black bear./ Paddington is chosen to represent England and run a stage in the relay of the Olympic flame, by chance!/ Mr. Curry then takes advantage of Paddington, saying he should try it now.

videos.overview: Paddington goes to a royal banquet in Luxembourg./ Paddington triggers a new gold rush./ Paddington produces a movie to enter a film festival.

videos.overview: Paddington tests Mr. Curry's hammock./ Padding and Mr. Gruber head to Germany for a medieval festival./ Paddington doesn't have a bedroom.

videos.overview: Paddington goes to the hospital after he gets his limbs and chest glued together. / Paddington and Mr. Gruber enroll in a military-school, and are rewarded for catching a pair of burglars. / Paddington becomes the latest victim of a conman.

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: Barney and the kids help Baby Bop count to ten by playing games, and visiting a Make-Believe Market.

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: Nick's homework is to find as many squares as he can. It's great fun when Barney and the kids help!

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: Kami, one of Barney's youngest friends, has trouble keeping up with the other kids and she's tired of always being last. She's not having a very good day.

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: It's a rainy spring day, and the children can be found inside painting and creating. Barney arrives, explains the differences amongst the seasons, and suggests playing outside in the rain. The rain is soon replaced by sunshine and a rainbow.

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: Every day with Barney is fun—but today is extra special. It's Barney's birthday!

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: Tony shares a box full of numbers that he made with his dad. He is showing them off when a gust of wind blows them all away. Barney and the kids decide to go on a number hunt. They soon find Baby Bop and their hunt takes the group all over the park.

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: Barney and the kids are excited because five of Mr. Boyd's brass-playing buddies are putting on a show in the park tonight! Angela is learning to play the trumpet and knows that it takes a lot of practice. BJ arrives and the group visits the caboose.

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: After a brief misunderstanding, BJ realizes he has many friends. He enjoys a day playing with Barney and the children.

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: The children work together to make a bird house. They are happy to learn that the bird will have lots of company; many animals make their homes in the park too!

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: The kids have put together a "Caboose Color Collection" which showcases the primary colors—red, yellow and blue. Barney and Baby Bop enjoy songs and games suggested by the colorful objects.

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: Barney and the kids help Mr. Boyd prepare his dog Bingo for a trip to the veterinarian for a check, while learning lessons about caring for dogs at the same time. Meanwhile, BJ is searching for his missing baseball, which he suspects was buried by Bingo.

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: When Sarah accidentally spills red paint into the blue paint, a mess turns into a perfectly purple day. The children paint pictures, make purple flowers and plan a purple party for their friend Colleen.

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: While Barney has fun with his friends every day, there's something special about making a brand NEW friend! When Mr. Boyd's niece, Colleen visits the park, she's eager to make friends with the other kids...but being the "new kid" isn't easy.

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: Barney and his friends play hopscotch—with a twist. Whitney is learning about triangles at school, so Angela created Triangle Hopscotch to help reinforce "triangles."

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: Through pretend play, Barney, and the children learn about their community and the people that help them live safely and happily there.

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: The children are invited to a family picnic in the park, but don't know who invited them. The invitations instruct them to bring a family treasure, so each child has something special with them. Barney helps lead a discussion about families.

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: A "too hot" afternoon becomes a "totally cool" day when Barney introduces his friends to the wonders of water.

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: While Barney and the children wait for Mr. Boyd's new fountain to be delivered, they have fun playing in and exploring the park.

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: Barney helps his young friends find good ways to express and deal with angry emotions.

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: Mario is trying to write his very own fairy tale. The children help by acting out some of their favorite fairy tales to give Mario some ideas.

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: The children are surprised to learn that playing games and having fun in the park is great exercise. Baby Bop is happy to learn that not only is she exercising while she plays, but exercise will make her grow big and strong.

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: Although the park may be a home away from home for Barney and his friends, BJ wants to build his own "totally awesome, completely cool" house. While BJ works on his house, Barney and the children learn all about houses and homes.

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: With a little Barney magic, the children experience the differences between day and night!

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: When Tony brings his kite to the park to show his friends, it accidentally blows into the branches of a tree! While waiting for a breeze to blow the kite down, Barney, Baby Bop and the kids play games about "up" and "down."

videos.title: Barney & Friends
videos.overview: Barney, Baby Bop and the kids learn all about “on” and “off” by playing games together.
